explication: Open Generative AI is a generative-media studio spanning image, video, audio, and workflow-oriented tools, with a standalone desktop app and a hosted Next.js surface. The standalone user flow starts at the app shell, selects a studio, configures a prompt/model, and submits generation through a MuAPI client or— for supported image models—local inference. The README documents additional studios whose runtime wiring was not sampled; those are represented as capability nodes without guessed call paths. The graph reflects source-index references and excerpts; unsampled implementations limit some relationships.
